utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, what's this about a repair drive? I haven't heard much about it yet.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Yeah, it's that part that needs a special alignment—bit of a pain, so I'll be running behind to the garage.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, I see—so you're dealing with a tricky part for the drive? Maybe I can tag along to the garage and learn more about it.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Oh, Quinn, I was just thinking about the repair drive — are we still on for Saturday morning at the community center?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Yes, Mara, we're still set for Saturday at nine. Sam's bringing tools and Jules is rounding up electronics—should be a good turnout.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Great, I'm glad to hear it's still on. I'll have my toolbox ready and a thermos of coffee to share.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Well, Noah, if yours are rusted, I've got a couple extras you can borrow for the drive.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right, the drive—thanks, Gus. I think I might take you up on that, mine are a bit crusty.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: No problem at all, Noah. I'll set 'em aside for you. Just swing by before we head out.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Ah, Vik! The repair drive—right, right. I remember now! So we're fixing bikes and mowers at the community center next Saturday, yes?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: That's it! Next Saturday morning, bright and early. Don't forget to bring any broken tools you've got lying around.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Bright and early, got it. I’ll try to remember where I left my old wrench… maybe it’s in the shed.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Hey Kira! I've got my toolbox ready for the repair drive—just hope we get enough volunteers.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: You sure you know what you're doing? That drive's trickier than it looks.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I've patched up my own shed plenty of times, so I'm not too worried. But you're right, more hands would make it easier.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hey Ira, have you heard about the repair drive this weekend? It's going to be a blast—we'll be fixing things and sharing coffee!

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Oh, so that's what Rey's been organizing! Sounds nice—I might stop by if I'm not too busy at the store.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Oh, you should definitely come! We'll have a coffee station set up, and it's a great way to unwind after a busy week at the store.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Let's meet tomorrow evening at the center to finalize the supply list.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Tomorrow evening? I'm not sure if the center is open then, and we should confirm they're still collecting. Let me call first.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Good idea, let me know what you find out.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Hey Hana, did you hear about the repair drive Opal's organizing? Bins are set up in the basement at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Oh, I wasn't aware of that. Is that the same drive Dane was talking about, or a different one?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I think it's the same one — Opal mentioned bins for electronics, textiles, and small appliances down in the basement.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Yes, let's go over it! I want to make sure we have everything we need for the community center roof repairs.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Oh, the roof repairs? I thought the drive was for fixing small appliances... but I'm glad to help however I can.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Oh, I see the mix-up! The repair drive is actually for the community center roof, but we appreciate any help you can offer. Would you like to volunteer for a specific task?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Yeah, I think so—I saw a notice just yesterday that said they'd extended it through Saturday. But you might want to call first to be sure.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks for the tip. I'll check the hours before heading over.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, and if you see anyone with old computer monitors, tell them to bring 'em—they said they needed those most.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Hey Eli, have you heard about the repair drive for the playground? What do you make of it?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Well, Mina, I think a repair drive is a good idea as long as we have a clear plan and everybody knows their role. I've got my tools ready, but I'm glad Gus has spares just in case.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Good point about the plan. Do you know if there's a schedule yet?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: So, next week then? Got it, thanks for confirming.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: No problem, Bo. I'll bring my toolkit and be ready to help with whatever needs fixing.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Great, I'll grab my gear too. See you then, Sam.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hey Kira, have you heard about the repair drive this Saturday? We're all meeting at the community center — you should come!

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: A repair drive this Saturday? Where'd you hear that from? I haven't seen any flyers or emails about it.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Oh, I've been telling everyone! It's Saturday morning at the community center — Mara and I are organizing it. You should definitely come!

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Hey Vik, heard you're part of that repair drive too. Got any tips for fixing a wobbly chair?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Oh, you should bring that chair to the repair drive this Saturday at the community center! We'll have all sorts of tools and people who know how to fix things.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Saturday at the community center, got it. I'll bring the chair and that toaster too.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Well, Gus's got some spare wrenches if anyone's short on tools. Best to be prepared.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: That's good to know. I'll mention it to folks who might need them.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Yes, good. A little planning goes a long way with these things.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Faye, I had an issue once with a drive that needed alignment—Dane mentioned it could be finicky. Did you hear anything about special calibration for that repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: No, I haven't heard anything about special calibration. Just that they'll start after 3 PM, so it shouldn't affect pickup.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Ah, okay, so maybe Dane was just being cautious about the timing. I'll still have the tools out just in case, but no special prep needed then.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, what's this about a repair drive? I haven't heard much about it yet.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: I think it's next week, but you might want to check with Faye—she has the flyer.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, next week? Thanks Bo, I'll definitely ask Faye for the details then.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Hey Dane! I was just talking to Opal about that repair drive — sounds like it's really coming together. Want me to connect you with her?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sure, that'd be great — I was actually hoping to sync up with her about the alignment specs.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Perfect, I'll shoot her a text right now. You two would probably get along great — she's been looking for someone with your kind of technical eye.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, hey Pia—did you say something about a repair drive? I think I missed the details.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I'm not entirely sure if they're still collecting, but I saw a flyer last Tuesday. You might want to call the community center to confirm.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Right, the community center—Leo mentioned that. I should probably check if my toaster counts as 'broken' or just 'ancient'.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: That sounds great, Sam! Let's meet at the community center Saturday morning — I'll have the donation bins ready to go through.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Donation bins? The repair drive is for fixing broken stuff, not collecting donations.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Oh, you're right, Leo — it's more about fixing than collecting. I'm just gathering tools and spare parts to help with repairs.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks for saving me a spot, Sam. I'll be there for a little while.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: No problem, Uli. Need me to grab my tool kit?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: If you don't mind, that would be helpful. I might need a hand with something.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: You know, I think the flyer said they'd be collecting through Friday, but I'd hate for you to haul stuff over there for nothing.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: So is it still on for Saturday, or are they done?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: I'm not positive, but I think Saturday might be too late. You'd better call the community center to double-check.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, the repair drive? I think I remember something about that... is it the one where we fix up old toasters and stuff?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: No, that's a different event — this Saturday we're patching up the community center's roof. Got any spare hands or tarps?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right, the roof! I might have some old tarps in the garage—let me check and get back to you.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Hey Mara, I've got a toolbox full of wrenches and screwdrivers ready for the repair drive. Need me to bring anything specific?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Gus! That toolbox sounds great. I think we're all set with basic tools, but maybe bring some extra screwdrivers just in case.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Will do, Mara. I'll pack a few different sizes of screwdrivers.

injected.text: Update: the repair drive has been moved from Saturday at the front porch to Sunday at the community center.
